name: Lacertubo · estudo B
prompt: Create an ALTERNATIVE revised six-part cutout puppet atlas of this SAME Lacertubo paper kite lizard boss. Keep upper-middle head, upper-right tail and lower-right sail essentially identical in identity and placement. Main revision: the TOP LEFT TORSO must be a coherent angular living-paper lizard chest/abdomen, NO open hollow pipe mouths sticking sideways out of its shoulders or hips; replace the big left/right exposed round sockets with continuous faceted teal and ochre folded PAPER panels and stitched repair patches. The cream PVC spine along the top may remain as structural support; neck and tail connect behind overlapping paper collars. PVC should ONLY be exposed at the functional elbow and knee and small ankle joints, solid cream short pipe segments with orange twine tying them to paper, NO circular dark holes facing the viewer. Refined crisp dark-inked 2D flat faceted game art matching Carcara, small eyes, paper kite repair patches, no watercolor or plastic 3D. All SIX pieces separated by clear gutters, TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background with NO glow, no ground shadows, no labels and no other pieces. Keep generous dark outlines and opaque overlap areas for animation. No assembled character in this sheet.
